THE RESTORE PASS'S OWN POOL (part B's one picked dial, disclosed): B_R = 40% x BUDGET fresh (the sequencing's own allocation) rather than a session-wide shared intervention pool — a shared pool's equal-share denominator (416 events) would cap the anti's FIRST stroke 5x below e294's form and break the 'e294's form' premise; the per-phase ledger (S_corpus <= B_C, S_anti <= B_E, S_restore <= B_R, each by the triangle bound) replaces the single-pool standing condition, and the pooled alternative is co-reported.
